tranche.aggregate: sum NAV, cash, units, fees and gross buy-plus-sell notional scaled by one sixth
tranche.turnover: on each execution date, summed scaled gross notional divided by summed scaled pretrade NAV

bootstrap.statistic: difference of annualized compounded growth rates
bootstrap.sampling_unit: aligned net monthly return vectors, not resampled price histories

risk.risk_free: Kenneth French captured monthly RF in decimal units
risk.beta: OLS with intercept: portfolio_return - RF on SPY_return - RF
risk.daily_metrics: preserve daily maximum drawdown and daily-return volatility separately

judgment: report calendar sensitivity and uncertainty without claiming optimal frequency, causal timing attribution or successful risk elimination
human_review: three owner checkpoints pending actual answers and demonstrations
publication: local review package first; publication authorization and verified deployment recorded separately
